title: The 4 Best Pressure Washers for Decks
h1: The 4 Best Pressure Washers for Decks
metaDescription: Our 4 picks for pressure washers for decks, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at pressure washers for decks using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Sun Joe SPX3000 Electric Pressure Washer
products.blurb: Key specs: 2030 max PSI, 1.76 GPM max flow, 5 quick-connect spray tips including a wide 40-degree fan, Dual detergent tanks for deck cleaner and rinse-aid.
strengths: Included 40-degree wide fan tip is the gentlest option in the box, well suited to softwood decking
Dual detergent tanks make it easy to run a dedicated deck cleaner without swapping containers
Widely reviewed and easy to find replacement nozzles and parts if one wears out
limitations: No dedicated low-pressure deck mode, output control depends entirely on nozzle choice and distance
2030 PSI still requires discipline on aging or already-weathered boards
Plastic housing feels less durable than the Karcher K5's build over years of seasonal use
features: 5 quick-connect spray tips including a wide 40-degree fan
Dual detergent tanks for deck cleaner and rinse-aid

products.name: Greenworks GPW1501 1500 PSI Pressure Washer
products.blurb: Key specs: 1500 max PSI, 1.2 GPM, Upright hand-carry design, Turbo nozzle included.
strengths: 1500 PSI ceiling is the closest of any model here to the generally recommended safe range for softwood
Lightweight, hand-carry design is easy to move around a deck without dragging a cart
Compact enough to store in a closet between seasonal uses
limitations: 1.2 GPM flow means slower rinsing on a large deck versus higher-GPM units
No included wide fan-tip specifically marketed for wood, relies on the turbo nozzle used carefully at distance
Not powerful enough for driveway or concrete duty, a second unit may be needed for other surfaces

products.name: Karcher K5 Premium Full Control Plus
products.blurb: Key specs: 2000 PSI, 1.4 GPM, Vario Power adjustable spray wand, Water-cooled induction motor.
strengths: Vario Power wand lets you dial pressure up or down at the nozzle without swapping tips, the most convenient adjustable control in this list
Water-cooled induction motor is rated for a longer service life under repeated seasonal use
Two-year limited warranty is longer than most competitors in this price range
limitations: Costs meaningfully more than the Sun Joe or Greenworks options
1.4 GPM flow is lower than the Sun Joe SPX3000's 1.76 GPM, so rinsing large decks takes a bit longer
Bulkier housing than the compact Greenworks GPW1501

products.name: RYOBI 2500 PSI 1.2 GPM Brushless Electric Pressure Washer
strengths: Enough pressure for decks and siding
limitations: Use wide tips on soft wood

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
